permissionCaveats: Reported push/admin permissions are read-only metadata observations; branch creation, image workflow token push, Actions availability and merge writes were not exercised in this preflight.
No missing repository was observed. Missing repository-creation capability therefore does not block any of these 20 existing repositories.
Artifact presence does not establish complete implementation, correct circuit, full MIT text, PNG integrity, meaningful tests or successful target build.
